title: CPSC, Reed & Barton Announce Recall of Infant Teething Rings
summary: The area where the teething ring is soldered together contains flux, which can irritate the skin or mouths of young children. Units: About 200.

title: CPSC, Deere & Co. Announce Recall of Lawn Tractors
summary: The fuel tank can crack and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 8,000.

title: CPSC, Kent International Inc. Announce Recall of "Midget Racer" Mini-Bicycles
summary: The front fork assembly on these mini-bicycles can loosen or break, and cause the rider to lose control and crash. Units: 28,000.

title: CPSC and Value City, Schottenstein Stores Announce Recall of Dried Flower Candles
summary: When burned, the dried flowers in the candle can catch on fire, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: 6,400.

title: CPSC and Value City, Schottenstein Stores Announce Recall of Gel Candle Kits
summary: When burned, the gel candle can melt the plastic candleholders included with the kit, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 2,300.

title: CPSC, Black & Decker (U.S.) Inc., Announce Recall to Repair Cordless Electric Lawn Mowers
summary: The clips holding the control cable to the handle may be missing, which could cause the blade control device to fail and keep the mower blade running, when it should stop. If the blade control device fails, consumers could suffer serious injuries. Units: 1,300.

title: CPSC, MCM International Announce Recall of Electric Pressure Washers
summary: MCM International imported the pressure washers from a manufacturer in China, who installed counterfeit ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) plugs on some of the units, without MCM's approval. title: CPSC, Easy Gardener Inc. Announce Recall of Ross Root Feeders
summary: The mixing chamber caps on these feeders can detach during use and strike nearby consumers, resulting in injuries. Units: About 345,000.

title: CPSC, Eddie Bauer Outlet Stores Announce Recall of Stainless Steel Lunch Bottles
summary: The insulated bottles have a weak seal and can leak hot liquids, which poses a serious burn hazard to consumers. Units: 4,000.

title: CPSC, Intermatic Inc. Announce Recall of Nightlights
summary: The nightlights can short-circuit, posing shock and burn hazards to consumers. Units: 156,000.

title: CPSC, Micro-Mark Announce Recall of Butane Micro Torch Lighters
summary: The lighters do not have a child-resistant mechanism, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards. Units: About 260.

title: CPSC, Vector Manufacturing Ltd. Announce Recall of Power Inverters with GFCI Outlets
summary: The GFCIs on the inverters, which are intended to protect consumers against shock and electrocution, could fail to operate correctly. Units: 1,600.

title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of Dehumidifiers
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1.4 million.

title: CPSC, Custom Buoyancy Inc. Announce Recall of Scuba Diving Devices
summary: The overpressure valve can stick in the open position, posing a drowning hazard to divers. Units: 7,700.

title: CPSC, Lands' End, Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Blankets
summary: Some of the blankets may contain a loose connection, that may cause the unit to not function or to short-circuit, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 15,000.
